notes.title: Version 1.2.10
notes.content:
Thank you for playing PC Tycoon 2! Version 1.2.10 changes:
- Stores tab in upgrades: you can invest money in your products distribution to sell more copies and get more fans
- Balance changes: marketing affects fans number and you gain fans faster
- Updated sandbox: you can now edit sales, fans and time flow speed multipliers
- Added “Help with translation” button, so that you can help improving game localization in your language
- Added czech and arabic languages support
- Some bug fixes and performance improvements
Have a nice game!

notes.title: Version 1.2.8
notes.content:
Thank you for playing PC Tycoon 2! Changes in version 1.2.8:
- Automatic closing of deals: when choosing the retail price of a product, you can also choose the price to sell to other companies or prohibit all transactions
- The slot machine, lottery and hacker attacks have been disabled at the request of the players
- Added windowed display mode
- Fixed a bug with downloading your own company logo from your device
- Improved translation into German, Indonesian, Hindi
- The thanks section has been updated
- Minor bugs fixed and overall performance improved
Have a nice game!
